caption: The drawing contains five rectangular swatches arranged in three rows. The top row features a single rectangle with a pattern of brown, blue, and beige ovals enclosed in blue and brown repeating shapes on a blue background. The second row has two rectangles: the left one depicts a floral pattern with blue and beige flowers and leaves on a brown background, while the right one has a repeated motif of blue, white-edged, round thistle-like shapes with small stems on a brown background. The bottom row displays two identical rectangles placed side by side, both featuring a plaid design with intersecting vertical and horizontal stripes in blue, brown, beige, and reddish-brown colors. All rectangles are set against an off-white or cream-colored background, on which the words "ALBERT LEVONE" appear printed below the bottom row.
title: Cotton Prints
